ops.intro: What the reactions slice left for the owner (`specs/reactions/spec.md`, Record).

ops.body: - **The sign once a moment has a reaction** (UI review U3): today it turns into the first reaction's glyph, so a plain smiling face can mean "no reaction yet" or "Happy", and the reaction is also spelled out under the dateline. Recommended: keep the face with a plus as the sign always and let the line under the dateline say what is chosen. It changes RX9, RX12 and decision 0168's "marked, the type's own glyph".

- **"Contents" as the way to the lenses** (the cold find, RX2): "Gather all my ideas" was found, but late: "Contents" reads as a book's table of contents, and Threads was tried first. Recommended: keep Contents (your call in 0172) and rename its spoken name and line only if the owner sees the same on a phone; the alternative is a reaction under a moment opening its lens, which you declined.

- [loop] **Reactions** (UI review U6, U8, U9): the panel above the bar while writing has no Done of its own (the sign shows it open; typing or the sign closes it); a lens card's More sits at its foot, as `MomentCard`'s does in the thread screens; the three faces may blur at a pin's bubble size, to check on a phone.
